The reconstructed \(7\times55\) matrix has rank \(7\), its Gram matrix has rank \(7\), and exhaustive enumeration of all \(128\) codewords gives exactly the claimed weight enumerator. All binary subspaces of \(\mathbb F_2^7\) through dimension \(6\) were enumerated in unique reduced-row-echelon form; the maxima \((0,2,4,6,10,17,30)\) imply the claimed generalized Hamming hierarchy by the standard column-subspace formula. The packaged verifier independently replays every finite step.

value.rationale: The source establishes \([55,7,25]\) as a new optimal LCD parameter realization but reports only ordinary distance-level data. The complete Hamming enumerator and all seven generalized Hamming weights are canonical structural invariants of this newly published representative. They refine minimum distance at every subcode dimension, expose the exact generator-column intersection profile, and provide a reusable benchmark for distinguishing future inequivalent optimal LCD constructions. This is a natural complete support profile rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
